purpose: Explain the observed September 17 inactivity using the unchanged production Nasdaq and leader gates, and an explicitly separate five-minute leader diagnostic. This is not a profitability study, parameter selection, deployment, or authorization to trade.
freeze_rule: This plan must be committed by the parent before collecting current-day data or generating audit results.
decision_clock: Every five-minute bar boundary from 09:35 through 12:15 Eastern, evaluated exactly at that boundary with end-stamped closed bars only. These are reconstruction clocks, not evidence of actual receipt times. Quarter-hour boundaries are labeled separately.

data.base: Reuse the existing immutable dataset-v1 fifteen-minute equity history through September 16.
data.history_start: Midnight New York time sixty calendar days before September 17, matching production rolling-window construction.
data.equity_collection: Alpaca IEX split-adjusted historical equity candles using the existing ReadOnlySession GET-only calendar and stock-bars allowlist. Fetch missing fifteen-minute history only if necessary, current-day fifteen-minute history, and current-day five-minute history through the fixed cutoff.
data.credentials: Read only the existing original private environment file into memory. Never save or print credentials, account identifiers, or request headers.
data.calendar: Use the authenticated exchange calendar and preserve session opens/closes, including early closes. Do not fill missing candles.
data.vix: Unavailable for today's audit unless the parent explicitly supplies a validated actual-index cache. No VIX API requests, ETF proxies, synthetic values, or prior-session values represented as current. Report unavailable VIX as unknown.

five_minute_diagnostic.method: Call the existing zones and reaction functions directly on genuinely five-minute bars. Reconstruct four-hour zones before the current five-minute candle starts. Never relabel five-minute bars as fifteen-minute data or substitute this diagnostic into the production analyzer.
five_minute_diagnostic.first_bar: A five-minute reaction requires two actual five-minute bars from the current session; the first current-session candle is insufficient and is reported explicitly.

outputs: Immutable sanitized current-day equity dataset, provenance, SHA-256 hashes, and per-symbol/frame coverage.
Every-checkpoint Nasdaq event/state/levels and production gate outcomes with actual VIX explicitly unknown.
Per-company latest actual bar, four-hour zones, current reaction vote, distance to nearest zone, and missing-data reasons for both genuine five-minute and production fifteen-minute frames.
Frame comparison counts across all checkpoints and separately at quarter-hour boundaries, with a chronological explanation of observed inactivity.

Explicit limitations: IEX-only trades, retrospectively fetched split-adjusted history, assumed observation clocks, no historical NBBO/arrival evidence, no current VIX evidence, no execution or profit claims.
exclusions: No backtest returns or trade simulation
No broker clients or order endpoints
validation: Network-free tests for strict cutoff and no future bars
Five-minute bars retain their true frame
Default fifteen-minute votes match production leader diagnostics
Same four-hour zone construction and reaction functions
